answer: Require every agent identity to lock a ferrous bond of tokens before it can transact: one identity, one bond, slashed on proven fraud. A gossip layer lets peers whisper attestations about behaviour, so a new identity starts at zero trust and must earn its way up. Cloning thousands of fake agents then costs thousands of bonds, and the attacker profit peaks at the zenith of the first few fakes before slashing wipes the rest, so sybil farming stops paying.
